name: adexto-envio
description: Envio HyperIndex indexer for AdextoFactory 0.11.0 and its curves on Monad mainnet.
//type: Required. Envio auto-loads src/handlers through tsx with a dynamic import(). Without this field the .ts files resolve as CommonJS, tsx falls back to require(), and loading them alongside the ESM 'envio' package they import fails with ERR_REQUIRE_CYCLE_MODULE — no handler registers and the indexer syncs zero events without reporting a cause.
